declarations.description: PIE Print Web Component Usage: ```html <pie-print></pie-print> <script> const player = document.querySelector('pie-print'); player.config = { item: { markup: '<multiple-choice id="1"></multiple-choice>', elements: { 'multiple-choice': '@pie-element/multiple-choice@12.0.0' }, models: [{ id: '1', element: 'multiple-choice', ... }] }, options: { role: 'student' } }; </script> ```
declarations.name: PiePrint

members.name: resolve
members.description: Custom resolver function for determining element URLs

members.name: loaderOptions
members.description: Where print modules load from and the optional element package policy. Read when `config` is set, so set it first. Declared ahead of `config` so a value set before upgrade is applied first.

members.name: trustMarkup
members.description: Render authored markup without sanitizing it. Off by default: authored item markup is treated as untrusted and passed through the shared sanitizer. Only set this when the host has already validated the markup.

members.name: sanitizeMarkup
members.description: Custom sanitizer, used instead of the default one. Ignored when `trustMarkup` is set.

members.name: config
members.description: Item configuration with elements and models
